findings: Explicit cache breakpoints have a 20-block lookback window.
Up to four explicit block-level breakpoints are supported.
Cache prefixes are ordered tools, system, then messages.
The cache usage field is cache_read_input_tokens.

decision: Ship the four-anchor placement: it is the only evaluated placement that moves the third anchor to the previous assistant-turn boundary and its simulated cache_read_input_tokens does not regress versus the current placement.
